day.note: hitherto goes the fifth wast booke

list.note: 21 Marcy 1643 [ie 1643/4] This Booke containeth three thowsand seaven hundred Fiftye seaven horses geldings and mares, with what Armes was listed with them, the value of all which (according to [th]e sev[er]all enteries before goeing) doth amount to Fiftye fower thousand seaven hundred seaventye fower pownds Eighteen shillings foure pence, whereof wee discharge our selves as followeth in [th]e dischardge of our whole Accompt John Smythe Tho: Richardson Comissaries
The 26th of Aprill 1644 Mr Smyth & Mr Richardson deliv[er]d this accompt upon their oathes Tho: Hodges Robt Ellis
25 July 1650 The above said Thomas Richardson made Oath to [th]e truth of this Acco[mp]t Before us Henry Robinson Will Maddison
4 Dec 1651 The above named John Smyth this day made Oath to [th]e truth of this Acco[mp]t Before us Ri: Wilcox Jo: Greensmyth
